script.text: In the Fusion Dimension, Obelisk Force continued their assault on the You Show Duel School.
We can't wait much longer! One of the Professor's enforcers just took down five of our strongest and turned them into cards!
Agreed. But I'll be going solo.
No, you can't go alone. You stay here and rest that leg. We can handle things!
Of course you can, but I'm not sure bringing the fight is right. There may be another way.
And that way is to talk this through with Leo Akaba personally.
Oh no you won't. To speak to the Professor, you must meet him first. And the only way to meet him is through me.
Dennis?!
Hi there, Zuzu. Long time no see. I did put on quite the performance, didn't I?
I had everyone fooled. But what can you expect from someone as talented a performer as me.
Is that so, Mr. McField.
You know him!?
It's been a while… Teacher.
Teacher?!
So Teach, tell me. You up for putting your razzle against my dazzle?
Zip it, red.
What are you doing here?
I did a little dimension hopping to help free a friend. The Professor is holding Lulu hostage, and you're going to tell me where he's keeping her… or I'll duel it out of you.
Duel it out of me? You're a regular laugh riot!
Funny, but I wonder if you'll be laughing after I tell you Duel Academy's starting to doubt the Professor and his plan.
Even your leader Aster Phoenix joined our side.
Is this true?
Yeah. After getting his deck handed to him by Yuya, Aster pulled a 180 on Duel Academy.
Yuya…
I can't believe Aster actually joined your side because of Yuya's lametaining.
Enough with all this chitchat. Let's get to dueling. Schooling you in front of our teacher will be so much fun!
On with the show!
